objective:
Goal: the page is shown at a permanent link to its current revision (the address includes oldid). Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "A permalink can be made by clicking "Permanent link" in the sidebar's toolbox.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, store the main heading of the page you end on as 'landed_on', then verify the goal on screen.
